name: Dumbbell Step-Up
summary: A single-leg exercise stepping up onto a box with dumbbells to train the quads and glutes and build unilateral strength.
setup: Place a sturdy box or bench in front of you, about knee height or lower.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and brace your trunk.
execution: Place your whole front foot on the box.
Press through the front foot to stand up, bringing the other foot onto the box.
Stand tall at the top, then lower the trailing leg back down slowly under control.
Keep the movement driven by the working leg rather than pushing off the back foot.
Complete all reps on one leg, then switch, or alternate legs.
mistakes: Pushing off the floor foot: keep it light and let the top leg do the work.
Box too high, causing the torso to lean forward: use a lower box.
Letting the knee cave in: push it out in line with the toes.
Dropping down quickly: lower slowly with control.
